messages:
Sam (PM): Quick sync — Large prospect asked for tenant BYOK, 6yr audit retention, and auditor-ready evidence bundles. Need quick gut-check on scope and blockers.

Cara (Sales): This is in our top pipeline. They want an API to request evidence and a predictable storage price.

Priya (Security): Security points: CMEK support (AWS/GCP/Azure) + wrapped DEK epochs so we can decrypt historical logs after key rotation. Exports should include integrity proofs (hash lists or Merkle root) and a signature.

Elliot (Eng): Implementation sketch: daily compressed log chunks, retention tiers per tenant (90d/2yr/6yr), lifecycle to cold storage. Export job produces tar.gz with logs + manifest.json (file hashes) + merkle.sig + Redwood-signed attestation. Exports for TBs could take hours.

Jon (Legal): Export artifacts must include chain-of-custody (requester, approver, export hash, signer identity, timestamp). Recommend 5 business days SLA for standard exports. Also need legal-hold pinning flow with approvals.

Cara (Sales): Customers will accept Redwood-signed manifests initially; enterprise customers may ask for HSM/KMS-tied signing later. We should call that out as an enterprise add-on.

Priya (Security): HSM signing + attestation is feasible but higher effort. For MVP, Redwood-managed signing with time-stamp authority is fine. Document key-rotation implications clearly.

Elliot (Eng): Dev estimate: 4-6 weeks for MVP backend + export runner prototype, plus infra cost estimate for cold storage and egress. Need perf numbers to build retrieval SLA.

Sam (PM): Draft acceptance criteria: (1) CMEK support for hosted/dedicated, (2) tenant retention config up to 6yr, (3) exportable evidence bundles with manifest + Merkle + Redwood signature, (4) audit trail + legal-hold, (5) cost/price model for archival and exports.

ticket-bot: Created task PROD-7007 "Tenant BYOK + multi-year retention scoping" and assigned to @Elliot, @Priya, @Sam. Due in 7 days.

Sam (PM): Thanks — please post blockers in thread. I'll pull into roadmap sprint planning. :thumbsup:
